failed: I stay near the fire and watch the mist.
I bar the door with a broken plank and sit close to the fire.
fog.name: Fog-eyed mist
fog.note: It pressed flat against the stone, eyes blinking slow. It vanished after watching the fire.

worked: I set a bowl of stew on the table and tell the figure I have warm broth.
bloom.name: Coated Wanderer
bloom.note: It sat by the hearth, drank broth, and said the warmth was adequate. It seemed harmless and just needed a break.
